entries.rationale: SCRUM-886 evidence-drift fix (Contract skew run 41481067639 on main b06e40ac9486d2c97b631c3c9b9f88034f0621d4, which reported this path as a new unproven path): read components/leads/LeadWorkspace.tsx (the customers.getRelations call at 47:5), convex/leads.ts get and convex/customers.ts getRelations. The call sends { orgId: activeOrgId, customerId: lead.customerId } only when activeOrgId, lead?.customerId and canViewCustomers are all truthy, and otherwise the "skip" sentinel. lead is the result of api.leads.get, whose Doc<"leads"> spread carries customerId typed Id<"customers">, and getRelations declares customerId v.id("customers"), so key and type agree. The client file is byte-identical between 9139d164 and b06e40ac9; the path became unproven when #746 (SCRUM-886) changed leads.get to return vehicle: projectOptionalVehicleForRole(vehicle, role) instead of the raw vehicle. A scratch copy that restored only that one line made this path provable again (experiment, not committed); why that line defeats the extractor was not isolated. Aliasing lead?.customerId in a local const did not help, and the Convex file may not be edited here, so the path is accepted as unproven value debt. getRelations authorizes the tenant with VIEW_CUSTOMERS and filters every read by orgId and customerId. The fingerprint is computed here against the locally rendered current spec, not the production spec; a match with the production spec was not observed for this path. No runtime or full-contract certification.
